usedFor: Seven Time tracks work orders, and Google Drive shares a file when “New Work Order” runs “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Work Order” in Seven Time, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new work order can go out with a link to its drawings or checklist.

watchOut: “New Work Order” is polling, so the link goes out after a scheduled check.
